criterion_cards.criteria: Preserve valid observation-period fields/bytes while using the canonical period owner; include leap and ordinary February, quarter/year bounds, supported forms, and typed absence for missing/malformed/invalid months; downstream observation, household demography, and graph consumers quarantine invalid dates and never invent a concrete date. LA-031 is staged: period ownership, aliases, and actual consumers are the OBS-01 portion; common I/O/bindings/facade importer cleanup remains UDF-02.

For failures before publication, after a confirmed batch, and between metric frames, preserve the yielded prefix without duplicates or omissions; retain source-copy and row/metric resume cursors; verify IDs and shard counts through a small real Parquet reader and D2 artifact consumer. Exercise absent resume cursor and changed original source; this does not assert large-file memory bounds or remote-storage behavior.

Preserve the D4 output name, bytes, schema version, stage registration, ArtifactRecord/BuildRunManifest contract, and the four may_not_use_for limits. Invoke the registered stage and write the actual artifact, then reopen it through the public verified read_api and the existing consumer. Keep contract imports narrow and do not elevate producer_handoff_ready into governance permission.

Keep JSON/NPZ/Parquet output profiles stable across relocation; preserve atomic-write errors and diagnostics; keep synthetic validation payload explicitly non-observational; retain sequential memory scheduling; use canonical builders without wildcard common bootstrap. For LA-031, compare registered D0/P0, D1, D2, D4, D5 outputs for all five direct common importers. A D3-only parity witness is insufficient. Native Parquet/server-specific behavior stays deferred until exercised on its intended runtime.

Carry the verified product/workspace root through the installed ukraine-data CLI and existing ops runner; record actual gate argv, cwd, environment, exit and skip outcome with a private process fixture. Do not run apt-get, CPX62 provisioning, server-only C7 or server bootstrap on this macOS worktree. A fake child-process/CLI witness does not establish deployment or server lifecycle success; those require a separate intended Linux receipt.

Select one explicit old/new demographic snapshot, never mix targets/prior/donor filenames across layouts, preserve optional donor semantics, and reject missing/corrupt blobs or incompatible shapes. Bind the same versioned inventory into composite, targets, priors, and donor read_api consumers; retain static-aging controls. A reader-generated byte digest is not the producer's persisted inventory.

property.proxy_divergence: A common.py export/import check or the D3-only 10/10 parity witness does not prove registered D0/P0,D1,D2,D4,D5 output parity; this test invokes all five registered stage routes. For D5 the semantic JSON projection excludes `created_at` after parsing it and checking time_role, and excludes the release-manifest handoff sha only after recomputing each digest from its own request bytes, so byte equality for those clock-bearing JSON artifacts is not established. A layout reader-generated GenerationBasis can bind selected bytes but cannot prove the producer emitted a complete, versioned inventory; similarly a successful fake gate subprocess does not prove server lifecycle behavior.
negative_controls: Observation reader fails before first yield: fallback reads the byte-identical private copy, not the normalized source path.
Observation reader fails after a yielded metric and the original path changes: resume opens the same private copy and emits each observation ID once.
Registered D0/P0,D1,D2,D4,D5 outputs are compared against direct canonical builder results; D5 projected fields receive structural/digest checks.
Demography readers refuse mixed/incomplete old/new layouts, absent required members, malformed members and shape-incompatible peers; all reader forms share the same negative controls.
Installed console entrypoint reaches an isolated fake child process with exact argv, cwd and integration environment; no real server is started.
